title: Enterprise Connectivity: capacity amendments
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs capacity amendments for contract amendment.

## Policy clause 1
The contract status is active or suspended.

## Policy clause 2
The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized.

## Policy clause 3
The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes.

## Policy clause 4
The request external reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective interval beginning.

## Policy clause 5
Request and review events preserve those effective attributes.

## Policy clause 6
Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records.

## Policy clause 7
Refuse any change above resource-count ceiling or when completed monthly amendment count has reached monthly amendment ceiling.

## Policy clause 8
Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding.

## Policy clause 9
Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Evidence condition 1
For contract amendment, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The contract status is active or suspended. The evidence consists of contract identifier, status. Correlate the same contract identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Evidence condition 2
For contract amendment, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, status, request reference, source classification. Correlate the same evidence-event identifier, request reference to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Measurement basis
UTC calendar month containing the fixed current handling time. Count completed request events of source classification amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.

## Points of judgement
Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the resource-count ceiling, monthly amendment ceiling, negotiated pricing permission used by this rule.

## Record identity: contract amendment
An approved signed amendment changes capacity or contract attributes without changing lifecycle state. One persistent contract per signed resource scope.
